business_problem: CEMIG needed to improve service quality and accessibility for millions of customers across digital and traditional channels, especially in rural and underserved areas where preferences, infrastructure, and digital literacy vary widely.
solution_summary: CEMIG partnered with IBM Consulting to redesign customer engagement around AI-assisted, multichannel service. IBM used watsonx.ai as the core intelligence layer for virtual assistants, then combined it with open-source large language models such as Llama and Hugging Face plus NeuralSeek enhancements to improve response accuracy and contextual understanding. The team also unified the utility’s mobile app, online portal, WhatsApp channel, and related touchpoints so customers could move through a more consistent digital journey rather than encountering separate channel experiences. Those changes were paired with process optimization and self-service expansion, which let the utility serve a large, diverse population while still maintaining physical-branch service for segments that need it. The result is a customer-engagement model that uses agentic AI to blend digital assistance, channel integration, and back-end efficiency—improving satisfaction, reducing operating cost, and making digital support more inclusive across different customer groups.

solution_components.name: IBM Consulting
solution_components.role: Designed and executed the broader digital transformation and customer-engagement strategy for CEMIG.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Provides the intelligence layer used to develop and improve CEMIG’s virtual assistants.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Delivers customer-facing virtual-assistant experiences across CEMIG’s digital service channels.

solution_components.name: NeuralSeek
solution_components.role: Enhances the assistants with more accurate and context-aware generative responses.

solution_components.name: Llama
solution_components.role: Serves as one of the open-source large language models supporting the assistant stack.

solution_components.name: Hugging Face
solution_components.role: Provides open-source model resources used alongside watsonx.ai in the virtual-assistant solution.

data_flow: Customer interactions from WhatsApp, the mobile app, the online portal, and other service channels feed the watsonx.ai-based assistant layer, which combines open-source LLMs and NeuralSeek context handling to generate responses and then routes customers toward self-service completion or branch/agent follow-up when needed.
business_outcome: CEMIG raised digital engagement and customer satisfaction, lowered operating expense, reduced claims-related compensation costs, and created a more scalable service model across both digital and physical channels.
metrics: 82% of customers utilizing digital channels for service requests
90% reduction in financial compensation values related to the claims process
20% reduction in AHT of branch agents
architecture_clues: The assistant stack combines watsonx.ai with open-source LLMs and NeuralSeek.
Digital channel integration spans WhatsApp, mobile, web, IVR, and physical-branch interactions.
The transformation deliberately kept traditional service channels active for specific audience segments.
